title: CONFIRMED: Ripple Treasury + SWIFT | Delaware Upgrades for Crypto | Italy Says Eurosystem Onchain
description:
In this video:

Delaware Banking Modernization Act of 2026: first update in 40 years, trust banks authorized to hold digital assets in fiduciary capacity

Ripple Treasury document confirms strategic partnership with Swift, Refinitiv, and third-party vendors across the corporate treasury value chain

Bank of Italy Deputy Governor: entire Eurosystem integrating DLT into wholesale payments via Target2

SIX Group and Chainlink: $2 trillion euros in Swiss and Spanish equities now on-chain across 75+ blockchains

Securitize: Solana RWA total crosses $2 billion

US Navy Admiral confirms United States is running a Bitcoin node on the network

PACE Act introduced: bipartisan national payments license for fintech and crypto firms

DeFi Technologies secures $11 million institutional investment into Hedera exchange-traded products

Chainlink completes Deloitte SOC 2 Type 2 examination, only oracle with all three major enterprise certifications

WISe.Key SealCoin launches space drop on Hedera targeting the machine-to-machine economy
'
Networks covered: XRP Ledger, Hedera, Solana, Chainlink, Bitcoin

TIMESTAMPS:
00:00 - Intro: Delaware Banking Modernization Act of 2026
06:00 - Ripple Treasury + Swift: Strategic Partnership Confirmed
08:30 - Securitize: Solana RWAs Cross $2 Billion
09:30 - PACE Act: National Payments License for Crypto
10:30 - Chainlink + Deloitte: SOC 2 Type 2 Complete
12:00 - SIX Group + Chainlink: $2T Euros in Equities On-Chain
13:30 - Ripple Swell 2026: Applications Open
14:00 - US Admiral: "We Have a Node on the Bitcoin Network"
15:00 - WISe.Key SealCoin: Space Drop Live on Hedera
17:30 - DeFi Technologies: $11M Institutional Investment into Hedera ETPs
19:30 - Bank of Italy + ECB: Eurosystem DLT Integration Confirmed
24:00 - NatWest: Future of Digital Assets
25:00 - EU Study: 34% of Investors May Switch Banks for Crypto
27:00 - SEC/CFTC: Digital Commodities Ruling Breakdown
30:00 - Closing

Disclaimer: The information contained on YouTube is provided for general informational purposes only.

For more institutional blockchain coverage: https://genfinity.io
